title: Listening Drill — Tree census project
description: Student and tutor dialogue. One recording, four questions. Synthetic audio.

sections.title: Tree census project
sections.transcript:
STUDENT: I've started the project on trees on the university grounds. I was going to use a questionnaire, but testing it with one person made me realise that the questions were too broad.

TUTOR: In that case, try plot sampling first. But watch out for boundary errors. That can affect what you notice and what you end up writing down.

STUDENT: Would it help if I kept a daily log? I don't want to discover the problem only after I've handed everything in.

TUTOR: A better safeguard here is marked corners. Bring the field sketch to our next meeting, so we can check where the sample plots begin. There is no need to prepare the final presentation yet.
